## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,

  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,

  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

=== input/gh-376/ticket.md
# gh-376: Parity with dm.ai#672: optional Markdown 'format' on ADO description / field / comment / create tools

## Description

Parity for epam/dm.ai#672 (merged), the Java side of IstiN/dmtools-agents#805 (ADO shows raw Markdown). The agents side (IstiN/dmtools-agents#815, merged) already sends `format: 'markdown'` by default on the ado provider, so **Dart must accept and honour it** or ADO descriptions/comments render raw under the Dart runtime.

## Spec (Java `AzureDevOpsClient`)
New OPTIONAL param `format` (string, `html` default | `markdown`; case-insensitive, trim, `md` accepted; anything else = html) on:
- `ado_update_description {id, description, format}` and `ado_update_field {id, field, value, format}`: after the field op add JSON Patch op `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<referenceName>, value:"Markdown"}` (reference name after field-name resolution).
- `ado_create_work_item {…, description, format}`: same op for System.Description, only when a description is present.
- `ado_add_work_item_comment {id, comment, format}`: POST `…/comments?api-version=<v>-preview&format=markdown`.
omitted / html / unknown ⇒ **byte-identical previous wire format** (backward compatibility). Note: a field saved as Markdown cannot go back to HTML (ADO rule; mention in the tool description).

## Dart work
- Registry (`ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` / `ado_tools.dart`): add the `format` param to the 4 tools (descriptions as in Java `ado-tools.md`).
- Sync JS bridge handlers (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) and async client/CLI path: implement the op / query param.
- Tests (echo-server style): per tool markdown vs default vs unknown format; comment query param; create without description adds no format op; custom long-text field.
- Fixtures: `java_mcp_tool_params.txt` / drift lists (`scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh Java catalog).

## Not needed in Dart (checked)
- dm.ai#670 (`dmtools --help` opened the interactive picker): Dart's dispatcher already routes `--help`/`-h`/`help` to `_printHelp()`; only the no-arg case is TTY-dependent, like Java.
- IstiN/dmtools-agents#804 (ADO numeric ids / WIQL `[System.Id] = N` in requireTicket/buildEncodedConfig): pure agent JS, runs unchanged on the Dart QuickJS runtime.

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,
  'low': 4,
  'minor': 4,
  'lowest': 4,
  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

/// Jira-style priority names (Java `mapPriority`).
const _priorities = <String, int>{
  'blocker': 1,
  'highest': 1,
  'critical': 1,
  'high': 2,
  'major': 2,
  'medium': 3,
  'normal': 3,

  'trivial': 4,
};

/// Maps a priority name or `1`-`4` to the ADO priority number.
///
/// Throws [ArgumentError] (message = Java's text) for blank/unknown input.
int mapAdoPriority(String? priority) {
  if (priority == null || priority.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Priority must not be empty');
  }
  final p = priority.trim().toLowerCase();
  final number = RegExp(r'^[1-4]$').hasMatch(p) ? int.parse(p) : _priorities[p];
  if (number == null) {
    throw ArgumentError("Unknown priority '$priority'. Use 1-4 or one of: "
        'Blocker, Highest, Critical, High, Major, Medium, Normal, Low, '
        'Minor, Lowest, Trivial');
  }
  return number;
}

arguments.content:
### What changed
Added an optional `format` param (`html` default | `markdown`) to `ado_update_description`, `ado_update_field`, `ado_create_work_item` and `ado_add_work_item_comment`, matching Java dm.ai#672. Markdown adds a `/multilineFieldsFormat/<field>=Markdown` JSON-Patch op (or `&format=markdown` on comments); everything else keeps the previous wire format byte-for-byte.

### Key decisions
- One shared predicate `isAdoMarkdownFormat` (trim, case-insensitive, `md` accepted) used by both the async client and the sync JS bridge.
- Create adds the format op only when a description is present.
- `ado_update_field` resolves the field name first, then applies the format op to the resolved reference name.
- Fixtures regenerated via `scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py` from a fresh upstream `dm.ai` clone (not hand-edited).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/ado_work_item_ops_test.dart test/integrations/ado test/mcp
```

Added an optional `format` param (`html` default | `markdown`) to `ado_update_description`, `ado_update_field`, `ado_create_work_item` and `ado_add_work_item_comment`, matching Java dm.ai#672. Markdown adds a `/multilineFieldsFormat/<field>=Markdown` JSON-Patch op (or `&format=markdown` on comments); everything else keeps the previous wire format byte-for-byte.

### Key decisions
- One shared predicate `isAdoMarkdownFormat` (trim, case-insensitive, `md` accepted) used by both the async client and the sync JS bridge.

Implemented the optional `format` param (`html` default | `markdown`) on the four ADO tools, matching the Java spec in the ticket. The full suite passes (3949 tests), and the analyzer is clean.

**What changed**
- **Shared helper:** `isAdoMarkdownFormat` (trim, case-insensitive, `md` accepted). Anything else means HTML.
- **Patch ops:** Markdown adds `{op:add, path:/multilineFieldsFormat/<ref>, value:"Markdown"}` for `ado_update_description`, `ado_update_field` (after name resolution), and `ado_create_work_item` (only when a description is present).
- **Comments:** Markdown adds `&format=markdown` to the comment POST.
- **Both paths:** the async client (`ado_work_item_client.dart`, `ado_client.dart`, `ado_http_client.dart`) and the sync JS bridge (`ado_sync_work_item_ops.dart`) are updated. The registry in `ado_tools.dart` and `ado_ticket_op_tools.dart` gets the new param.
- **Tests:** added a `format parameter` group covering markdown, default, and unknown formats, the comment query, create without a description, and a custom long-text field. I also updated two hand-written catalog assertions that pinned the old param lists.

**Things to know**
- **Fixtures were regenerated, not hand-edited.** I cloned upstream `dm.ai` and ran `scripts/extract_java_tool_params.py`. That also moved unrelated entries (`ado_attach_file`, `ado_set_priority`, `ado_get_field_code`, `ado_create_work_item`) between the parity and drift lists. Those are upstream drift, not from this change, but they're in the diff and worth a glance in review.
